content:
macovedj opened PR #14443 from macovedj:wasi-preserve-accepted-peer to bytecodealliance:main:

Retain the peer address returned by accept and use it for accepted sockets' remote-address queries. Preserve outbound address queries and connection-reset I/O errors.

Add a Linux/macOS regression for querying the accepted peer after reset. Update cargo-fuzz to 0.13.2 so fresh CI installs use dependencies compatible with the pinned nightly; keep all fuzz-build checks unchanged.
